I study **[EDIT: your topic in one line — e.g. how daily emotional dynamics
unfold within families, using intensive longitudinal designs]**. My work
combines diary and experience-sampling data with latent-variable and
multilevel models.

Methodologically I spend most of my time in structural equation modelling,
multilevel and dynamic SEM, and the practical business of fitting these models
to messy real data — missingness, convergence, and the gap between a model that
runs and a model that means something.

I also care about making these methods learnable. I write and teach
[statistics workshop material](outreach.qmd), and I keep a public record of the
[projects that did not work out](projects.qmd), because the published record is
a poor guide to how research actually goes.
